title: MirrorCraft: Paired Evaluation under Hidden Rule Changes in Minecraft
abstract: arXiv:2607.29218v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: With the rapid progress of large language models (LLMs), an interesting question has emerged: how do LLM-based agents perform in Minecraft? To date, most Minecraft benchmarks evaluate them under fixed game mechanics, which are extensively documented online. High performance in these settings does not show whether an agent can continue making progress when familiar recipes, drops, and other rules change. In this paper, we introduce MirrorCraft, a paired benchmark for evaluating agents under hidden rule changes in Minecraft. Each Mirror world is a copy of its paired Vanilla world, with selected server-side rules silently modified by the datapack of one rule suite. Terrain, spawn, resource placement, task, interface, and action budget remain matched within every Vanilla-Mirror pair. translated_title: MirrorCraft：Minecraft中隐藏规则变化下的配对评估
translated_abstract: arXiv:2607.29218v2 公告类型：替换 摘要：随着大语言模型（LLMs）的快速进展，一个有趣的问题浮现出来：基于LLM的智能体在Minecraft中的表现如何？迄今为止，大多数Minecraft基准测试是在固定的游戏机制下评估智能体，而这些机制在网上有大量的文档记录。在这些设置中取得高表现，并不能说明当熟悉的合成配方、掉落物和其他规则发生变化时，智能体是否还能继续取得进展。在本文中，我们提出了MirrorCraft，一个用于在Minecraft隐藏规则变化下评估智能体的配对基准测试。每个Mirror世界是其配对Vanilla世界的副本，其中一个规则套件的数据包会悄悄修改选定的服务器端规则。在每个Vanilla-Mirror配对中，地形、出生点、资源分布、任务、界面和行动预算均保持一致。MirrorCraft包含五个受控生物群系中的10个Vanilla世界、六个规则套件和三个进度任务，我们评估了两个LLM和六种智能体配置。
tldr: MirrorCraft提出了一种配对基准测试方法，通过在Mirror世界中悄悄修改服务器端规则、同时保持其他条件与Vanilla世界一致，来评估LLM智能体在Minecraft中面对隐藏规则变化时的适应能力。
en_tdlr: MirrorCraft introduces a paired benchmark that silently modifies server-side rules in Mirror worlds while keeping all other conditions matched with Vanilla worlds, to evaluate LLM agents' ability to adapt to hidden rule changes in Minecraft.
